title: Request a Statement Credit or Fee Adjustment
summary: This document explains how to request a statement credit or ask for a fee adjustment on a Rho-Bank credit card for situations such as annual fee concerns, late payment fee issues, interest charged in error, service problems, and billing errors. Requests are made via 1-800-RHO-BANK, the Rho-Bank mobile app chat, or rhobank.com/help; approvals are reviewed case-by-case using account history and circumstances.
